title: A boundary-addition identity for Weil-Petersson volumes and their supersymmetric generalizations
summary: We consider $V_{g,n}(\{b_i\})$, the Weil-Petersson volumes of the moduli space of Riemann surfaces of genus $g$ with $n$ geodesic boundaries of lengths $b_i$, $(i=1,...,n)$, and various ${ N}{\geq}1$ supersymmetric generalizations of them, using a framework within which they are specializations of a larger family of quantities naturally governed by the integrable KdV hierarchy. An exact boundary-addition identity is derived that directly relates $V_{g,n+1}(\{b_1,b_2,...,b_n,b\})$, for any $b$, to the corresponding $n$-boundary KdV data underlying $V_{g,n}(\{b_1,b_2,...,b_n\})$.
